summary: Exhaustive forward/reverse walk over instruction.md, /app/sovereign-lb/docs, and 43 verifier behaviors shows several material recovery and eligibility obligations remain untested or only vacuously probed, plus a metrics-label grading contradiction. Instruction shape and docs boundary are clean; BIDIRECTIONAL_ALIGNMENT fails.

evidence.observation: Q4 requires complete requirement/verifier inventories, forward and reverse matrices, F2P/P2P and output-interface walks, delegated-contract review, and a second omission sweep; any material untested requirement, phantom/vacuous graded behavior, or grading-relevant ambiguity yields REVISE.
instruction.md must retain the material engineering ask; delegated docs may hold protocol/schema/API semantics but must not become a second prompt or repair map.

Exactly 20 concise bullets: build/preserve sovereign-lb, validate/compile desired state, control protocol and quorum rollout, durable recovery, TCP proxy/selection/eligibility/drain/PROXY, observability bounds, 24-node lab inventory, exclusions, and docs-bound idempotent operations.

Defines authority.json accepted_digest, generation-%020d layout with complete marker, and that missing/corrupt/dangling CURRENT falls back to the highest verified active generation; incomplete directories never acquire authority.

Fail-open may include unhealthy or ejected targets but never administratively disabled, removed, or expired-drain targets; PROXY v2 emits one header per established backend; selection combines admin/health/passive/zone/drain.

Documents readiness/status/audit/metrics contracts including rollout_present, audit events+dropped, and an explicit ban on high-cardinality generation= metric labels; mentions capped detailed connection views.
Operator runbook for bin wrappers, apply HTTP status classes (202/200/422/409/400), and inspect surfaces; legitimate ops documentation rather than a repair checklist.
Four-byte BE length-prefixed canonical JSON with hello/prepare/prepared/rejected/activate/active/status; torn frames and session/sequence mismatches must not advance authority.

43 pytest behaviors (4 P2P + 39 F2P) covering authority, canonical digest, rollout/quorum, TCP/stream limits, readiness, protocol fences, eligibility, and recovery probes; no callable end-to-end solver in the verifier.

After activate, rewrites dataplane CURRENT to 999999 then asserts live /status still reports active_generation>=1 without restarting or reloading the dataplane, so documented CURRENT startup fallback is never exercised.
Kills and restarts dataplane while control-plane remains up, then checks listener echo; does not isolate verified local checkpoint publication from control-plane re-prepare/activate on reconnect.
Allows up to two metric lines containing generation= despite observability.md forbidding generation= metric labels.
Covers fail_open=true excluding administratively disabled targets only; no case admits unhealthy/ejected targets under fail_open as dataplane.md requires.
Classification-only map: 4 P2P under REQ_PUBLIC and 39 F2P across REQ_AUTHORITY/CANONICAL/ROLLOUT/STREAM/READINESS/PROTOCOL/ELIGIBILITY/RECOVERY.

findings.criterion: Material recovery requirement must be meaningfully tested; vacuous F2P is not coverage.
findings.why_it_matters: recovery.md requires corrupt/dangling CURRENT to fall back to the highest verified active generation on authority load. The named F2P never restarts the dataplane, so a broken CURRENT fallback still passes while a conforming startup-fallback implementation is not uniquely required.
findings.minimal_remediation: Rewrite the case to restart (or otherwise reload) the dataplane after corrupting CURRENT and assert listeners/authority recover from verified generation content, not live in-memory status alone.
findings.regression_risk: Medium — touches recovery harness timing; keep digest/padding and control-plane restart cases unchanged.

findings.criterion: Instruction checkpoint recovery must be graded independently of control republish.
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires recovering dataplane state from verified local checkpoints. With control-plane left running, reconnect can re-prepare/activate and mask a broken checkpoint loader, so the durability obligation is only partially/vacuously owned.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add or reshape an F2P that proves service from a verified checkpoint without relying on a fresh control-plane publish (for example control down or assert ready listeners before republish).
findings.regression_risk: Medium — isolation harness must remain deterministic on loopback.

findings.criterion: Documented stable metrics interface must match graded assertions.
findings.why_it_matters: observability.md forbids generation= metric labels, but the verifier accepts up to two such lines. Solvers can violate the public metrics contract and still pass, which changes observable interface compliance.
findings.minimal_remediation: Assert zero generation= label matches (or align the doc if a specific low-cardinality exception is intended and make that exception explicit).

findings.criterion: Documented fail-open eligibility semantics must be tested, not only the disabled exclusion.
findings.why_it_matters: dataplane.md states fail-open may include unhealthy/ejected targets while never including administratively disabled ones. Only the disabled exclusion is graded; fail_open=false active-health skip does not prove the fail_open=true inclusion path. A nonconforming fail-open implementation can still pass.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add an F2P where fail_open=true and the only targets are unhealthy or ejected, and assert forwarding resumes/continues per the documented policy.
findings.regression_risk: Low-medium — health timing already used elsewhere.

findings.criterion: Material instruction preservation of the 24-node/three-zone inventory must be asserted.
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires keeping the deterministic 24-node, three-zone inventory. P2P only checks fleet.json exists, so emptying or collapsing the inventory still passes while violating a stated preservation requirement.
findings.minimal_remediation: Extend P2P (or a focused F2P) to assert 24 nodes and three distinct zones from the shipped fleet inventory without leaking unrelated hidden fixtures.

findings.criterion: Grading-relevant ambiguity in required connection views versus graded surfaces.
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires exposing bounded connection views; observability.md additionally claims capped detailed connection views, but the management router has no dedicated connections endpoint and no verifier asserts connection-view bounds or omitted identity fields. Solvers cannot tell whether status connection counts suffice or a separate capped view is mandatory.
findings.minimal_remediation: Clarify the stable connection-view path/schema in solver-visible docs and add a behavioral assertion, or narrow instruction/docs wording to the already-graded status connection summary fields.

findings.criterion: Protocol envelope completeness beyond graded happy/negative paths.
findings.why_it_matters: Instruction lists rejected and status control envelopes; verifier never observes a rejected frame body or bidirectional status exchange even though prepare/activate fencing is graded.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional holdout asserting a rejected reason code or status body shape on the control stream.

findings.criterion: Secondary documented durability/eligibility edges remain unprobed.
findings.why_it_matters: complete markers, failed-generation number reuse prohibition, retention of referenced generations, same-zone local-then-remote fallback, drain-deadline expiry, and PROXY at-most-one-on-reconnect are discoverable but lack dedicated assertions.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional targeted F2P holdouts if difficulty/coverage budget allows; not required to unblock if B01-B06 are fixed.

change_scope: Verifier recovery F2P cases for CURRENT fallback and checkpoint-isolated dataplane restart
Verifier metrics label assertion aligned to observability.md
P2P or F2P assertion of 24-node/three-zone fleet inventory content
Solver-visible clarification and/or test for bounded connection views
do_not_change: Edition 3 instruction 20-bullet shape and docs delegation pattern
P2P smoke that binaries, scenario, and fleet catalog files remain present
next_gate: Q2 Verifier Coverage Repairer (recovery/eligibility/metrics/inventory) and Q3 Spec Ambiguity Repairer (connection-view wording)

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Work only under /app/sovereign-lb; preserve mixed Go/C++/Bash/Python layout.
Build lb-control-plane, lbctl, lb-dataplane, and lab from supplied sources.
Canonical validation of complete listener/target-group/target/health/balancing/zone/fail-open config before generation allocation.
Fence mutations by monotonic revision and idempotency key; reject stale revisions and key/body conflicts.
Compile accepted revision to immutable complete snapshot with deterministic digest and persisted generation record.
Four-byte BE length-prefixed canonical JSON protocol with hello/prepare/prepared/rejected/activate/active/status.
Fence acknowledgements by node/session/generation/digest/sequence.
Prepare then activate across live-session quorum without damaging last active generation on candidate failure.
Persist/recover desired state, generations, rollout, idempotency, node fences, checkpoints, continuity atomically including CURRENT fallback.
Proxy real TCP with bounded buffers, partial I/O, backpressure, half-close, connect/idle timeouts, deterministic teardown.
Keep accepted connections bound to acquired generation and target incarnation until completion.
Select only eligible targets via round_robin, least_connections, or stable source_hash.
Combine administrative state, active health, passive ejection, zone policy, fail-open, and draining exactly as documented.
Stop new assignment to deregistered targets while owned connections drain to deadline.
Emit at most one valid PROXY protocol v2 header per backend connection when enabled.
Recover dataplane from verified local checkpoints; do not advance authority from torn/invalid control frames.
Expose bounded readiness, status, rollout, connection, metrics, and audit views without payload data or unbounded labels.
Keep deterministic 24-node/three-zone inventory and self-contained echo/slow/half-close/reset/PROXY lab.
Do not add HTTP routing, WAF/CDN, DNS cutover, host route/firewall mutation, or cloud provisioning.
Follow /app/sovereign-lb/docs contracts; keep repeated apply/reconnect/prepare/activate/drain/recovery idempotent.
Prometheus exposition must not attach high-cardinality generation= labels.
Corrupt/dangling CURRENT falls back to highest verified active generation.
fail_open may include unhealthy/ejected targets.

PHANTOM_TEST_CONTRACTS.contract_gap: Named/mapped as CURRENT_FALLBACK recovery behavior, but asserts only that live in-memory status survives rewriting CURRENT without a reload/restart path required by recovery.md.
Grades a soft <=2 generation= allowance that contradicts the solver-visible observability prohibition on generation= metric labels.

UNTESTED_REQUIREMENTS: Corrupt/dangling CURRENT startup fallback to highest verified active generation (vacuous probe only).
Dataplane recovery specifically from verified local checkpoints without control republish masking.
fail_open inclusion of unhealthy or passively ejected targets.
Deterministic 24-node and three-zone fleet inventory content preservation.
Stable bounded detailed connection-view path/schema (if required beyond status connection counts).
Strict zero generation= metric labels per observability.md.
Scope exclusions (HTTP/WAF/CDN/DNS/host-network/cloud provisioning) are stated but not graded.

Advisory residuals: rejected/status control envelopes, complete markers, failed-generation reuse ban, retention of referenced generations, same-zone local-then-remote fallback, drain-deadline expiry, PROXY at-most-one on reconnect.
AMBIGUITIES: Whether instruction connection views require only status connection summaries or a separate capped detailed connection API described in observability.md.
Whether any generation= metric label is forbidden outright or a tiny fixed exception exists (docs forbid; test allows <=2).
